title: Education for Peace II
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as organised mass murder and crimes against humanity characterised by the intention to exterminate individuals because they belong to a particular national, ethnic, racial or religious group."

Genocide is defined as organised mass murder and crimes against humanity characterised by the intention to exterminate individuals because they belong to a particular national, ethnic, racial or religious group.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means deciding about your own lifestyle."
Learning means deciding about your own lifestyle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a three-unit course that has minimum duration of one semester."
PCR211 is a three-unit course that has minimum duration of one semester.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to describe how people and animals learn, thereby helping to understand the inherently complex process of learning."
A learning theory is an attempt to describe how people and animals learn, thereby helping to understand the inherently complex process of learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ultimate goal of traditional justice systems among most African communities."
Reconciliation is the ultimate goal of traditional justice systems among most African communities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basis of freedom, security and equitable relationships and a process for a life of reconciliation."
ANV is the basis of freedom, security and equitable relationships and a process for a life of reconciliation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that people consciously engage in processes that enable different stakeholders to commit and pool their resources and talents in order to secure peace in their communities."

Grounding peacebuilding in relationships means that people consciously engage in processes that enable different stakeholders to commit and pool their resources and talents in order to secure peace in their communities.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a natural expression of this consciousness; however, peace remains the underlying value and the instrument by which this unity is achieved through interdependence."
Diversity and differences are a natural expression of this consciousness; however, peace remains the underlying value and the instrument by which this unity is achieved through interdependence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that has commonly been ascribed to Johan Galtung."
Structural violence is a term that has commonly been ascribed to Johan Galtung.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique that expands the possibilities for both the prevention of conflict and the making of peace."
Peacekeeping is a technique that expands the possibilities for both the prevention of conflict and the making of peace.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessary condition for nearly all human attainment because for peace to reign, people have to learn to rely on one another."
Co-operation is a necessary condition for nearly all human attainment because for peace to reign, people have to learn to rely on one another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way of life that is deeply rooted in spiritual tradition that could be active or passive."
Active Non-Violence is a way of life that is deeply rooted in spiritual tradition that could be active or passive.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition of peace and of human survival. 'Peace' cannot be viewed as an end in itself unless it means 'peace with recognition of the interests of the poor'."
Security is a condition of peace and of human survival. 'Peace' cannot be viewed as an end in itself unless it means 'peace with recognition of the interests of the poor'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the absence of direct violence even where other forms of visible threats exist."
Negative peace refers to the absence of direct violence even where other forms of visible threats exist.
fib: ______ is an effective political tactic that has been used in liberation struggles to win national independence (India), build trade unions and stop wars in time past.
Active Non-Violence (ANV)
Active Non-Violence
ANV
Active Non-Violence (ANV) is an effective political tactic that has been used in liberation struggles to win national independence (India), build trade unions and stop wars in time past.
______ is the core element of positive peace.
Social justice
Social justice is the core element of positive peace.
______ refers to the general social process by which human beings acquire the knowledge and skills needed to function in their culture.
Informal education
Informal education refers to the general social process by which human beings acquire the knowledge and skills needed to function in their culture.

______ is a term introduced by Boutros-Ghali in his Agenda for Peace (1992), which means to employ military power beyond that of peace-keepers to enforce agreements against any party violating such agreements.
Peace enforcement

Peace enforcement is a term introduced by Boutros-Ghali in his Agenda for Peace (1992), which means to employ military power beyond that of peace-keepers to enforce agreements against any party violating such agreements.
______ is the most secure basis for peace.
Development
Development is the most secure basis for peace.
______ is an integral part of local dispute resolution practices in many African countries.
Truth telling
Truth telling is an integral part of local dispute resolution practices in many African countries.
______ is a term that has a more recent origin.
Peacebuilding
Peacebuilding is a term that has a more recent origin.
______ is responsible for maintaining international peace, and for restoring peace when conflicts arise.
UN Security Council
The UN Security Council is responsible for maintaining international peace, and for restoring peace when conflicts arise.
______ is the greatest constraint against deployment of peacekeeping forces.
Lack of funds
Lack of funds is the greatest constraint against deployment of peacekeeping forces.
______ refers to the discontent people feel when they compare their positions to those of similarly situated and find that they have less than their peers.
Relative deprivation
Relative deprivation refers to the discontent people feel when they compare their positions to those of similarly situated and find that they have less than their peers.
______ are made up of contingents from several countries.
UN peacekeeping personnel
UN peacekeeping personnel are made up of contingents from several countries.
______ is a way of life that is deeply rooted in spiritual tradition that could be active or passive.
Non-Violence
Non-Violence is a way of life that is deeply rooted in spiritual tradition that could be active or passive.
______ is one of many human achievements, or put differently, a part of overall human achievement.
Peace
Peace is one of many human achievements, or put differently, a part of overall human achievement.
